decisions.choice: embed is a separate batch port in packages/ai, not a new TASK_ID on the JSON-task Provider interface.
decisions.justification: TaskDef/Provider.call return parsed JSON (packages/ai/src/types.ts:20-60); embeddings return float vectors in batches. The India-only guard reuses isIndiaRegion from packages/ai/src/policy/residency.ts as embeddings.ts does.

decisions.choice: Per-run cost budget is enforced inside the job from the gateway's costPaise, and spend is logged; no new audit or budget table.
decisions.justification: Platform ports are OCR-specific (packages/core/src/ai/platform-ports.ts, corpus_ocr_call); a new global table would add RLS-catalog and registry work beyond this issue. ADR 0051 §Vectors only requires metering through the gateway.

decisions.choice: HNSW indexes are created in the migration on the (empty) partitions rather than in a post-backfill step.
decisions.justification: Hand-written partition DDL is already the pattern (migration 20261030211330_corpus_segments.sql); the indexes exist for the EXPLAIN/iterative-scan test, and incremental inserts into them are acceptable at current volume. The issue's 'after backfill' wording is noted as a tradeoff in the report.

decisions.choice: Model-choice report states measured mock-embedder numbers and marks real-provider numbers pending; dimensions stay at 1024.
decisions.justification: No provider credentials are available (#112); all three candidate models support 1024 (ADR 0051 §Vectors, docs/adr/0051-corpus-storage-enrichment-and-retrieval.md:118); the real run is the deferred R18.
